title: Weak Scalability of time parallel Schwarz methods for parabolic optimal control problems
summary: Parabolic optimal control problems arise in numerous scientific and engineering applications. They typically lead to large-scale coupled forward-backward systems that cannot be treated with classical time-stepping schemes and are computationally expensive to solve. Therefore, parallel methods are essential to reduce the computational time required. In this work, we investigate a time domain decomposition approach, namely the time parallel Schwarz method, applied to parabolic optimal control problems.
